title: Enzyme-free isolation of mesenchymal stem cells from decidua basalis of the human placenta
protocol: Collect the placenta and umbilical cord in an aseptic tray after cesarean delivery.
Flip the placenta over so that the maternal surface (decidua basalis) is facing upwards.
Cut pieces of approximately 0.5 cm thickness from the decidua basalis tissue layer using a sterile, sharp pair of scissors.
Transfer the cut pieces to a 50 mL sterile centrifuge tube containing 20 mL of solution.
Wash placental tissue pieces thoroughly with normal saline until all traces of blood and blood clots are removed.
Disinfect the washed placental tissue meticulously before further processing.
Transfer tissue pieces to a sterile 50 mL centrifuge tube containing 30 mL of normal saline supplemented with 1x Antibiotic-Antimycotic solution and an additional 12.5 μg/mL of amphotericin B.
Incubate the tube at 4°C for 1.5–2 hours.
Transfer tissue pieces to a laminar flow hood after incubation.
Dip the tissue piece three to four times in a 15 mL centrifuge tube containing sterile PBS to wash it.
Transfer the tissue piece to another 15 mL centrifuge tube containing sterile PBS and dip it three to four times.
Submerge the tissue piece in a tube containing 70% ethanol for exactly 15 seconds.
Immediately transfer the tissue piece to another tube containing sterile PBS and dip it three to four times to remove any traces of ethanol.
Repeat step (e) three more times.
Place a washed tissue piece onto a 90 mm sterile petri-plate.
Store the tube containing the other pieces on ice.
Cut the tissue piece into small explants of 3–5 mm using forceps and a scalpel fixed to a scalpel holder.
Carefully plate about 10–15 explants onto a 35 mm sterile tissue culture dish using fine forceps.
Allow the explants to air-dry for 5–7 min to facilitate attachment.
Add 2 ml of warm fresh MSC isolation medium drop-wise, gently, taking care not to dislodge the explants.
Maintain tissue in a CO2 incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Discard leftover minced explants in a biohazard waste bag.
Collect liquid waste in a beaker containing sodium hypochlorite solution.
Change the medium with 2 ml of warm MSC isolation medium after 48 hours.
Perform subsequent media changes every 72 hours.
Reduce amphotericin B concentration to 1.5 μg/ml on the 8th day.
Further reduce amphotericin B concentration to 0.75 μg/ml on the 11th day.
Remove MSCs from explants using sterile blunt-end tips when sufficient cells have emerged, approximately 14 days post-plating.
Add 2 ml of warm fresh MSC isolation medium without additional amphotericin B to the dishes after removing explants.
Check the confluency of cell patches on dishes after 24–48 hours of explant removal.
Aspirate the medium from the dishes.
Wash cells twice with DPBS.
Add 250 μL of TrypLE to each 35 mm tissue culture dish and incubate at 37°C for 4-6 minutes.
Add 1 mL of warm fresh MSC growth medium to the dish.
Collect the cells and transfer them to a 15 mL sterile centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 24°C–26°C for 2 minutes at 500 × g.
Aspirate out the medium supernatant.
Add 500 μL of warm fresh MSC growth medium to the cell pellet to suspend it.
Take a 10 μL aliquot of the cell suspension to count cells using a hemocytometer.
Seed placental MSCs at a density of 6000 cells/cm² in 2 mL of warm fresh MSC growth medium in a 35 mm tissue culture dish.
Culture cells for 72 hours until they are 70–80% confluent.
Warm TrypLE, MSC growth medium, and DPBS to 37°C before starting the cell detachment process.
Detach cells with 250 μL of TrypLE.
Add 1 mL of warm fresh MSC growth medium to the detached cells.
Transfer the mixture to a 15 mL centrifuge tube.
Take an aliquot for counting cells.
Centrifuge remaining cells at 500 × g for 2 minutes at 24°C–26°C.
Aspirate the supernatant and suspend the cells directly in freezing medium at approximately 2 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Put the cell suspension into cryogenic vials and place them in a Mr. Frosty freezing container containing isopropanol.
Keep the Mr. Frosty freezing container in −80°C freezer for ∼24 hours before transferring the cryogenic vials to a liquid nitrogen tank for long-term storage.
Take out a cryogenic vial with frozen PL-MSCs from the liquid nitrogen tank and immediately transfer it to a beaker containing water at 37°C for gentle thawing.
Add 1 mL of warm fresh MSC growth medium to the cryogenic vial containing thawed cell suspension.
Mix thoroughly.
Transfer the contents to a 15 mL centrifuge tube containing approximately 3 mL of additional warm fresh MSC growth medium.
Centrifuge the cells at 500 × g for 2 minutes at 24°C–26°C.
Aspirate the supernatant carefully.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 500 μL of warm, fresh MSC growth medium.
Add 2 mL of warm, fresh MSC growth medium to a 35 mm tissue culture dish.
Transfer the cells and gently swirl to distribute them evenly across the dish.
Replace the medium with 2 mL of warm, fresh MSC growth medium the next day.
After 48 hours of reviving and plating, detach the cells with TrypLE.
Count the number of detached cells.
Seed an appropriate number of cells for the next passage.
Aliquot 1 × 10^5 cells or 50 μL of cell suspension in each pre-labeled 5 mL FACS tube.
Add the respective antibodies to the tubes and incubate in ice for 1 h.
Acquire at least 10,000 events on BD LSRFortessa Cell Analyzer flow cytometer.
Analyze the results using BD FACSDiva software.
Seed isolated PL-MSCs at a density of 6000 cells/cm^2 on a 35 mm tissue culture dish in 2 mL of warm, fresh MSC growth medium.
Incubate the dishes at 37°C and 5% CO2 until they reach 85-90% confluency.
Remove the growth medium from the dishes.
Add 2 mL of pre-warmed differentiation medium to initiate in vitro differentiation.
Continue adipogenic differentiation for a total of ∼20 days or until matured oil drops become visible within the cells.
Maintain uninduced control cultures at an identical density and in MSC growth medium for a similar duration.
After completion of differentiation, stain the adipogenic differentiated dish with Oil Red O.
Aspirate the medium from the adipogenic differentiation dish.
Wash the dish with PBS at 24°C-26°C.
Fix the cells with 4% PFA in PBS and incubate for 20 min at 24°C-26°C.
Wash the dish with PBS again.
Add 60% isopropanol to the dish and incubate for 3 min at 24°C-26°C.
Remove the isopropanol and add 1–2 mL of Oil Red O stain solution.
Incubate the dish in dark for 60 min at 24°C–26°C.
Give three washes with double distilled water to remove excess stain.
Add a small amount of double distilled water to the dish to prevent the cells from drying.
Visualize under bright field microscope.
Aspirate the medium from the osteogenic differentiation dish.
Wash the dish with PBS at 24°C–26°C.
Fix the cells with 4% PFA in PBS and incubate for 20 minutes at 24°C–26°C.
Wash the cells twice with double distilled water.
Add 2 mL of 1% Alizarin Red S solution to the dish.
Incubate the dishes in the dark for 1 hour at 24°C–26°C.
Wash the cells twice with double distilled water to remove excess stain.
Add a small amount of double distilled water to the dish to prevent the cells from drying.
Visualize the stained cells under a bright field microscope.
Aspirate the medium out from the dish.
Wash the cells with DPBS.
Fix the cells with 1% PFA in PBS for 20 min.
Remove the PFA, wash the cells with PBS.
Add 0.1% Toluidine blue stain (in 1% PFA) to the dish for staining.
After 1 h, remove the stain from the dish.
Give two consecutive washes with double distilled water.
Manually count the stained colonies and report the data as a total number of colonies per 100 cells plated.
Count the cell numbers using a hemocytometer during passaging of cells.
Calculate population doublings and population doubling time for passage 1 to passage 6.
Plate PL-MSCs at a density of 6000 cells/cm² on glass cover-slips.
Incubate at 37°C under standard culture conditions for 72 hours.
Aspirate the medium after 72 hours.
Transfer the cover-slips to clean 35 mm tissue culture dishes for further processing.
Give two consecutive washes with PBS at 24-26°C.
Add approximately 1.5 mL of 4% PFA in PBS to each dish with cover-slips for fixation.
Incubate the cells on cover-slips for 20 minutes at 24°C–26°C.
Wash the cover-slips twice consecutively with PBS at room temperature to remove all traces of PFA.
Perform permeabilization by adding 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS to the cover-slips and incubating for 10 minutes at 24°C–26°C.
Wash the cover-slips once with PBS to remove Triton X-100.
Add approximately 1.5 mL of 3% BSA in PBS to each dish containing the cover-slips and incubate for 60 minutes at 24°C–26°C.
Add primary antibodies, vimentin at a 1:150 dilution, Stro-1 at a 1:100 dilution, and Oct-4 at a 1:400 dilution in 3% BSA to the cover-slips for staining.
Incubate with primary antibodies as per manufacturer’s instructions.
Keep cover-slips at 4°C for 12–16 h in a humidified chamber or box.
Remove primary antibody and wash cover-slips three times with PBS (each wash of 5 min) at 24°C–26°C.
Add secondary antibodies to the cover-slips in 1:500 dilution in 1.5% BSA in PBS, incubate for 1 h in dark.
Wash cover-slips three times with PBS (each wash of 5 min) at 24°C–26°C to remove secondary antibody.
Add DAPI (1:5000 dilution in PBS) to each dish containing the cover-slips and incubate them for 10 min in the dark.
Wash cover-slips three times with PBS (each wash of 5 min) at 24°C–26°C to remove DAPI.
Mount cover-slips using VECTASHIELD as anti-fade mounting medium.
Capture cell images at 24°C–26°C at 40× magnification using fluorescence microscope.
Seed PL-MSCs at a density of 6000 cells/cm² on a 35 mm tissue culture dish.
Incubate the dishes at 37°C and 5% CO₂ for 72 hours.
Aspirate the medium from the dish.
Wash the dish with PBS at 24°C–26°C.
Add 500 μL of RNAiso Plus to the dish for total RNA isolation.
Determine the concentration of isolated RNA using a NanoDrop spectrophotometer.
Prepare cDNA from the isolated RNA using Verso cDNA synthesis kit.
Quantitative reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction (qRT-PCR) using PowerUp SYBR Green Master Mix to detect and quantify mRNA expression for vimentin (VIM).
Use TaqMan Gene Expression Assay (FAM) and TaqMan Fast Universal Master Mix to detect and quantify the mRNA expression level for Oct-4 (POU5F1).
